note: signup: the free-guide sign-up and the coaching waiting list both post to one Google Form (no backend needed). form_id is the long id in the form's pre-filled link (docs.google.com/forms/d/e/<form_id>/viewform); entries are the entry.N numbers for the Email, Name, Goal, Language and Source questions. Empty form_id = the form copies the details and opens an Instagram message instead. guide.pdf = file name inside site/guide/ (empty = 'we will send it' message).

coaching.note: Future coaching price (Abdullah, 9 Oct 2026): 100 KD/month or 240 KD/3 months. Not shown on the site until show_price is true.

seo.note: Search and sharing tags (site/seo.py). base_url = the public address of this site/ folder, ending in '/'. Placeholder until the domain exists (launch ~Jan 2027). indexable stays false while the site is a private draft: every page says noindex and robots.txt blocks crawlers. At launch set the real base_url and indexable true, then rebuild.
